title: Quantum groups and braid groups as fundamental symmetries
container-title: European Physical Society Conference on High Energy Physics (EPS-HEP 2017), Venice, Italy, 5-12 July 2017
note: arXiv:1711.09011v1 [physics.gen-ph], 21 Nov 2017. Conference name, dates and the pos.sissa.it licence line read from page 1 of the PDF; the PoS article number is not printed on the arXiv copy and is not added. Ingested 2026-11-22 as library/arxiv-1711.09011v1/ from an owner chat upload. Reviews SU_q(3) as a flavour symmetry (q a root of unity chosen by fit to baryon masses) and uses the Kauffman-Lomonaco Clifford braiding theorem to show C and H represent B_2 and the circular B_3^c of the helon model. HUMAN-REVIEW: unreviewed.
